_doc: Declared runtime-state tracked files that must NOT gate the worktree_isolation ff-only-pull exception (PENDING-ARMS 'Pro main self-align strutturalmente chiuso', opened 2026-07-06, iteration 5). These are files that are TRACKED in git (so plain untracked-file exclusion doesn't cover them) but are CONTINUOUSLY rewritten by live runtime processes on a specific machine — cron logs, published-content indices, generated reference docs. A tracked-dirty repo normally shuts the ff-only exception (fail-closed default: any tracked mutation might collide with an incoming fast-forward). These 3 files are the DECLARED exception: dirty-but-expected runtime residue, never a sibling's in-flight edit. Anything NOT on this list still gates the exception exactly as before (W91 lesson: an exception is a guard with inverted sign — it needs its OWN guilt+innocence proof, not just an innocence case). Consumed by worktree_isolation._main_tree_tracked_clean(). Paths are REPO-RELATIVE (matched against `git status --porcelain` path column, exact match only — no globs, no prefix match, so a NEW file under the same directory does NOT silently inherit the allowlist).

entries.reason: cron/agent escalation append-log, rewritten continuously by Pro-side automation
WR2/article-composer publish-state index, rewritten on every publish cycle
generated automations reference doc, regenerated by a Pro-side doc-sync cron
